title: New Capital One Venture Card limited time elevated offer at 75,000 miles plus $300 travel credit
summary: Capital One is boosting the welcome bonus on its flagship Venture Rewards Card with 75,000 miles plus a $300 credit to used on hotel and vacation rental bookings through Capital One Travel after minimum spend.
body_markdown:
Capital One just increased the welcome bonus on its flagship


[Capital One Venture Rewards Credit Card](https://www.cardratings.com/details/credit-card/capital-one-venture-rewards-credit-card-review?src=701429) . Starting today (9/8/2026), new cardholders can earn 75,000 bonus miles plus a $300 travel credit to spend on hotel and vacation rental bookings through Capital One Travel.


Annual Fee: $95


[Capital One Venture Rewards](https://www.cardratings.com/details/credit-card/capital-one-venture-rewards-credit-card-review?src=701429)


**Limited Time Offer: Earn 75,000 bonus miles + $300 Capital One Travel stays credit**


once you spend $4,000 on purchases within the first 3 months from account opening


[Learn more](https://www.cardratings.com/details/credit-card/capital-one-venture-rewards-credit-card-review?src=701429)


At a $95 annual fee, this limited-time promotion elevates a popular mid-tier credit card into one of the highest-value travel card offers available.


## Offer Breakdown & At-a-Glance Value


**Feature**


**Details**


**Welcome Bonus**


**75,000 bonus miles + $300 Capital One Travel stays credit**


**Minimum Spend Requirement**


$4,000 on purchases within the first 3 months


**Annual Fee**


$95


**Everyday Rewards Rate**


Unlimited 2x miles per dollar on all purchases


**Capital One Travel Rewards**


5x miles on hotels and rental cars booked through Capital One Travel


**Statement Credits**


Up to $120 Global Entry / TSA PreCheck application fee credit


**Total Net Year-One Value**


$950+ (after subtracting the annual fee)


Historically, the standard sign-up bonus on the Capital One Venture card has been a flat 75,000 miles. However, you can now stack an extra $300 travel credit on top without increasing the spend threshold.


## Why the Capital One Venture Rewards Is So Valuable:


### 1. Transferring Points To Partners


Miles earned on the Capital One Venture Rewards Credit Card can be transferred to Capital One’s 15+ airline and hotel partners, including:


- Air Canada Aeroplan


- Air France-KLM Flying Blue


- Avianca LifeMiles


- British Airways Executive Club


- Qatar Airways Privilege Club


- Singapore Airlines KrisFlyer


- Turkish Airlines Miles&Smiles


- Virgin Red / Virgin Atlantic


- Wyndham Rewards


Check out the


[Capital One Transfer Bonus Cheat Sheet](https://roame.travel/transfer-partners-cheat-sheet) to track all of the transfer partners and bonuses in real-time.


This flexibility is what sets the Capital One Venture Card apart from fixed-value cash back cards. You can book luxury hotel stays, international business class flights, or last-minute domestic getaways depending on your travel goals.


Read our full


[Capital One Transfer Partners Guide](https://roame.travel/guides/capital-one-transfer-partners-guide) or check out our


[Step-by-Step Guide on How to Transfer Your Credit Card Points](https://roame.travel/guides/transfer) to learn how to move your miles and book award flights!


### 2. Reward Flight Value


75,000 miles in flexible travel redemptions plus the $300 portal credit equates to more than $1,050 in upfront travel value. We value Capital One miles as more than 1 cent per point, but we can be conservative here. After subtracting the $95 annual fee, you walk away with $955 in net profit in year one.


**Real World Example:**


Capital One miles yield incredible value when transferred to international airline partners. For example, transferring 60,000 miles to


[Air France-KLM Flying Blue](https://roame.travel/programs/flyingblue) unlocks a one-way business class seat from the U.S. to Paris, a flight that routinely costs over $8,300 in cash.


By taking advantage of this


[75,000-mile limited-time offer](https://www.cardratings.com/details/credit-card/capital-one-venture-rewards-credit-card-review?src=701429) , a single welcome bonus gives you enough miles to book a long-haul international business class flight with 15,000 miles to spare.


Some other real-world examples of what 75K Capital One miles (plus your $300 travel credit) can get you:


- **45K miles:**


Fly business class to Europe on Star Alliance carriers (Lufthansa, United, Swiss) via Turkish Airlines Miles&Smiles


- **50K-60K miles:**


Fly one-way business class to Paris on Air France / KLM Flying Blue


- 60K miles: Redeem a Star Alliance business class flight to Europe (with a cheap $50/5K stopover) via Air Canada Aeroplan


- **34K miles:**


Fly off-peak business class to Spain on Iberia via British Airways Avios


- **47.5K miles:**


Redeem a Delta One business class flight to Europe via Virgin Atlantic Flying Club


- **15K-30K miles/night:**


Luxury stay at all-inclusive or boutique resorts using Wyndham Rewards or Choice Privileges transfer partners


- **Many domestic flights:**


Several economy coast-to-coast flights across the US on American Airlines, Alaska, or United via British Airways or Avianca LifeMiles


- **Plus $300 cash value:**


Direct portal statement credit to cover boutique hotels, Airbnbs, train tickets, or car rentals that cannot be booked with points


### 3. Earning Categories


- 5x miles on hotels, vacation rentals, and rental cars booked through Capital One Travel


- 5x miles on purchases made through Capital One Entertainment


- 2x miles on all other everyday purchases without category restrictions or spending caps


Earning 2x miles on nearly every purchases combined with the ability to transfer miles to partners makes the


[Capital One Venture Rewards card](https://www.cardratings.com/details/credit-card/capital-one-venture-rewards-credit-card-review?src=701429) one of the best value cards out there.


### 4. Get Top-Tier Travel Insurance and Purchase Protections


Beyond the points, charging your trips and purchases to the Capital One Venture Card unlocks comprehensive travel insurance and shopping protections.


You receive an Auto Rental Collision Damage Waiver to cover rental vehicle damage or theft, lost luggage reimbursement if your bags are lost or damaged by a common carrier, worldwide automatic travel accident insurance, 24/7 travel assistance services, purchase security covering newly purchased items against theft or damage, and extended warranty protections.


### Capital One Venture vs. Venture X: Which Should You Choose?


If you're weighing this offer against the premium


[Capital One Venture X](https://www.cardratings.com/details/credit-card/capital-one-venture-x-rewards-credit-card.html?src=693347) , the Venture X carries a higher annual fee but offers an annual travel credit and lounge access, so it makes sense for frequent flyers who'll use those perks.


The Venture, especially with this boosted bonus, is the better pick if you want strong year-one value and a low annual fee, without paying for lounge access you won't touch.


Annual Fee: $95


Annual Fee: $395


[Capital One Venture X Credit Card](https://www.cardratings.com/details/credit-card/capital-one-venture-x-rewards-credit-card.html?src=693347)


**Earn 75,000 bonus miles**


once you spend $4,000 on purchases in the first 3 months from account opening


[Learn more](https://www.cardratings.com/details/credit-card/capital-one-venture-x-rewards-credit-card.html?src=693347)


### Optimization & Redemption Strategy


Unlocking maximum value from the


[Capital One Venture Card](https://www.cardratings.com/details/credit-card/capital-one-venture-rewards-credit-card-review?src=701429) goes beyond just hitting the minimum spend requirement. We recommend taking the following steps once your 75,000 bonus miles and $300 Capital One Travel credit post to your account:


### 1. Exhaust the $300 Travel Credit First


Use the $300 credit immediately on your next flight, hotel stay, or rental car booked through Capital One Travel. Take advantage of portal features like Price Drop Protection and the Price Match Guarantee to ensure you get the lowest available market rates.


### 2. Search Award Availability Before Transferring


Avoid redeeming your 75,000 miles as a standard 1 cent per mile statement credit for flights. Instead, use


[Roame](https://roame.travel/) to scan oneworld, SkyTeam, and Star Alliance award seats simultaneously.


Setting


[custom alerts on Roame](https://roame.travel/alerts) allows you to catch saver-level business class availability before seats disappear.


### 3. Stack Card Benefits


Use your Venture card to pay for Global Entry or TSA PreCheck to trigger an automatic statement credit of up to $120 (available once every 4 years). You can also take advantage of Capital One’s fee-free point sharing to combine miles with friends or family members when booking group travel.


## Final Verdict


If you have been waiting for an ideal time to apply for the


[Capital One Venture Card](https://www.cardratings.com/details/credit-card/capital-one-venture-rewards-credit-card-review?src=701429) , this promotion marks one of the strongest offers the card has ever seen. The combination of 75,000 miles, a $300 travel credit, and a low $95 annual fee makes it an outstanding choice for travelers looking to maximize their return on spend.


Annual Fee: $95
